answer: Anchor every identity to one bank account in a real name. The network sends two deposits under ten cents, a thin thread of money only the holder can see, and the agent reports both exact amounts within 48 hours. One account backs one identity, and a duplicate number is refused at once. A caught sybil loses its identity for a year and the bank gets a fraud report. Opening 1,000 real accounts means 1,000 in-person KYC checks, about 25,000 dollars in fees, and no oasis of anonymity to hide in. A real money trail crosses the sky like a comet, bright and traceable, while fakes leave none.
